text:
sofia: Dropped updated frames for the billing table. Two patterns: visible per-month Download button vs compact row + small download icon + slide-out. Figma link in thread.

kai: I prefer visible Download button. Cuts support tickets.

rachael: Visible is clear, but tall. If visible, auto-collapse older months by default.

dennis: If compact, the icon must have aria-label and be keyboard-focusable. No hover-only controls.

alex: Also: rename Tokens -> "Compute tokens (est.)". Show $ estimates only in slide-out or CSV export.

sofia: Good call. Also moving the scope selector next to the date picker makes more sense UX-wise. Persist as ?scope=org or ?scope=project.

kai: Tooltip behavior: convert token hover tooltip into an inline popover that opens on focus/enter and supports ESC to close.

dennis: Contrast nit: axis ticks at 12px fail in dark mode. Bump to 13px and use higher-contrast color.

rachael: CSV exports should include both tokens and estimated_usd plus a header with scope + date range.

design-bot: Created ticket #5600: "Billing table: invoice affordance + a11y" and attached contrast report.

sofia: Action items: lean explicit Download + collapse older months OR hybrid with visible icon + slide-out; move scope next to date and persist; update microcopy; make popovers keyboard-accessible; bump axis ticks to 13px. Assigning: @dennis keyboard flow, @kai color QA, @rachael Figma updates. Follow-up sync Wednesday. :thumbsup:
